table.retrieve:
SELECT 
      source=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=theader.sgcode),
      target=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=theader.dgcode),
		username = users.username,
      theader.transcode,
      theader.date,
      theader.postdate, 
      theader.posted,
      stockvalue = Round ( Sum ( tdetail.qty *
							Case :ai_pricetype 
								WHEN 2 THEN Round(tdetail.purprice / tdetail.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 1 THEN Round(tdetail.Saleprice / tdetail.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 3 THEN Round(tdetail.avgprice, 2)
                     END ) , 0 ) ,
      theader.sgcode,
      theader.dgcode

 
FROM  tdetail,theader,users

WHERE theader.date>=:adt_sdate and 
      theader.date<=:adt_ldate and
      theader.posted='Y' and
      theader.transcode = tdetail.transcode and
		theader.salesmancode = users.usercode and
		theader.sgcode IN (:al_sourcegodown) and
		theader.dgcode = :al_targetgodown 

Group By theader.transcode,
         theader.posted,
         theader.sgcode,
         theader.dgcode,
			theader.date,
         theader.postdate,
			users.username
          
ORDER BY  theader.date,theader.transcode
